gloss: -year student; student in the nth year

definitions.gloss: student in the nth year (of a school)
definitions.explanation: Attached to a number to say what year of school someone is in: {一年生|いちねんせい} (first-year student), {三年生|さんねんせい} (third-year student). The school itself is understood from context or named separately.

examples.japanese: ⟦{弟|おとうと}→弟：00572_otouto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三年生|さんねんせい}→三年生：27560_sannensei⟧だ。
examples.english: My younger brother is a third-year student.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小学校|しょうがっこう}→小学校：01055_shougakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一年生|いちねんせい}→一年生：27559_ichinensei⟧になった。
examples.english: She started first grade in elementary school.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦{四年生|よねんせい}→四年生：28268_yonensei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{就職活動|しゅうしょくかつどう}→就職活動：14840_shuushokukatsudou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧。
examples.english: Fourth-year university students are busy with job hunting.

examples.japanese: {何年生|なんねんせい}です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{聞|き}かれて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧、⟦{中学|ちゅうがく}→中学：03477_chuugaku⟧⟦{二年生|にねんせい}→二年生：27586_ninensei⟧です⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{答|こた}えた→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧。
examples.english: When asked what year I was in, I answered that I was in the second year of junior high.

notes:
From ⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧ (year) + {生|せい} (student). The number takes the on'yomi: いち, ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧, さん, ⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧ (⟦{四年生|よねんせい}→四年生：28268_yonensei⟧), ご, ろく.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{小学|しょうがく}→小学：29351_shougaku⟧⟦{一年生|いちねんせい}→一年生：27559_ichinensei⟧: first-grader
- ⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧⟦{三年生|さんねんせい}→三年生：27560_sannensei⟧: third-year high school student (final year)
- {何年生|なんねんせい}: what year (question word)
- {新|しん}⟦{一年生|いちねんせい}→一年生：27559_ichinensei⟧: incoming first-year student

USAGE:
Japanese counts school years from one within each school, so a ⟦{中学|ちゅうがく}→中学：03477_chuugaku⟧⟦{一年生|いちねんせい}→一年生：27559_ichinensei⟧ is a seventh-grader in American terms. The school year begins in April, so students change year in the spring.
